en.projection: The four Web source profiles lower ExposedState Host projection into a standalone supporting helper. Names use the State semantic, falling back to the exposure key, and share the existing Module’s official aliases and normalization. Boolean true adds an empty attribute and false removes it; string/enum values write attributes, discrete numbers write attributes and CSS variables, and continuous numbers write only CSS variables by default. The JavaScript compile APIs accept the existing exposeStateWebMode flags allowStringVar and allowContinuousAttr. This is a Web extension, not a DOM projection promise for GPUI, Qt or Flutter.
en.evidence: The ExposedState repair separately mounts all four original Web Adapters alongside generated native consumers: 18 scalar/mirror surfaces exercise writes without structural rendering, real detach and retained-State remount; eight readonly surfaces exercise actual focus/blur and continuous Scroll projection. Actual WASM Worker comparison covers 23 successful complete outputs, the Web-only GPUI mode rejection, six unimplemented-profile rejections and four malformed mode requests. Earlier failed observations and corrected driver mistakes remain recorded. Canonical Web Component Root markers and native Scroll projection markers still differ, so these bounded observations are not complete Adapter parity or RuntimeBox migration.

en.ownership: Static Module declarations select the physical Root before rendering, but only an invoked hook activates its image or text properties. Inactive declarations must not overwrite consumer-owned alternative text, image fit or editing values. Generated Custom Elements mark the connected canonical host with data-pui-root, not a template child or physical image/input part; their constructors do not add host attributes. Activated Scroll surfaces expose the negotiated data-pui-scroll-projection marker, measured position/visible-ratio facts and view-scoped readiness. Detach returns the projection to unresolved; remount renegotiates the live Root. TextControl owns the client editing value, without a competing Vue 2 or Vue 3 VNode writer. Explicit updates preserve a composing value and composition end restores the controlled value; server serialization retains its separate value path.
en.evidence: The follow-up compiles seven controlled Prototype fixtures through the actual browser WASM Worker to all four Web source profiles: 28 complete outputs match Node, then the unmodified emitted modules mount beside their original Adapters as 56 real surfaces. Evidence covers inactive/active image and input declarations, controlled editing, ordered template children, measured Scroll requests, detach/remount and terminal cleanup. Composition events are synthetic events in Chromium, not OS/IME automation. The shared stylesheet supplies geometry only; it does not inject Module values, Root markers, overflow policy or Scroll facts. Raw attributes, markup and remaining Custom Element presentation differences are retained in internal/compiler/browser-wasm-evidence.json. This does not admit native widgets, SSR/hydration profiles, every canonical Demo, RuntimeBox mounting or an editor/security boundary.

zh.ownership: Static Module declaration 在 render 前选择 physical Root，但 image/text property 只在调用对应 hook 后激活。未激活 declaration 不能覆盖 consumer-owned alternative text、image fit 或 editing value。生成的 Custom Element 只给 connected canonical host 写 data-pui-root，不标记 template child 或 physical image/input part；constructor 不添加 host attribute。激活的 Scroll surface 投影 negotiated data-pui-scroll-projection marker、实测 position/visible-ratio fact 与 view-scoped readiness；detach 将 projection 退回 unresolved，remount 重新协商 live Root。TextControl 独占 client editing value，不再有 Vue 2 / Vue 3 VNode 的 competing writer。Explicit update 保留 composing value，composition end 恢复 controlled value；server serialization 保留独立的 value 路径。
zh.evidence: 后续修复在真实浏览器 WASM Worker 中，将七个受控 Prototype fixture 编译到四个 Web source profile：28 份完整 output 与 Node 一致，再将未经改写的 emitted module 与原 Adapter 并排挂载为 56 个真实 surface。证据覆盖 inactive/active image/input declaration、controlled editing、ordered template children、实测 Scroll request、detach/remount 与 terminal cleanup。Composition 输入是 Chromium 中的 synthetic event，不是 OS/IME 自动化。共用 stylesheet 只提供 geometry，不注入 Module value、Root marker、overflow policy 或 Scroll fact。完整原始 attribute、markup 与仍存在的 Custom Element presentation 差异保留在 internal/compiler/browser-wasm-evidence.json。这不等于 native widget、SSR/hydration profile、全部 canonical Demo、RuntimeBox mount 或 editor/security boundary 的准入。
